Hicks) launched Norwest Civil and Rail through a BHP
pilot program for local Indigenous businesses.
Her vision for Norwest was crystal clear from the
start: to support her growing family and to develop
opportunities for sustainable employment and independence underpinned
by a culture of taking pride in hard work and unfailing integrity. Never shy of a
challenge, Melanie’s drive and determination have seen the company develop
and expand into the multi-million-dollar operation it is today. It bears a new name
commensurate with the vastly broader range of skills, services and equipment it now
offers to best service its equally broad cross section of clients.

mine site gym facility stands as a benchmark for rapid, high-performance construction in
extreme environments, having been fully completed in just 30 days. Utilising our specialised insulated
panel system, we were able to significantly compress the traditional construction timeline while
delivering a structure specifically engineered for the harsh Australian climate.
A critical advantage of this build is the superior thermal performance of the
panel system. With a high R-value insulation core, the facility was designed
to maintain a stable, cool internal environment even when external
temperatures exceeded 40°C. This thermal efficiency not only ensures
a comfortable and safe training space for site personnel but also
drastically reduces the long-term energy costs associated with
cooling a large-scale facility in the desert heat.
